title: PlanningProvenance
description: Provenance record for an ai-code-planner session. This record must be attached to the frozen plan for auditability, per the ai-code-planner design specification (section 7.10). It captures who planned, with what topology, how many rounds ran, and what it cost.

mode.description: Planning mode used for this session.

topology.description: Panel topology. Must be null or omitted when mode is single-agent; required and non-null when mode is panel.

panelMembers.description: Ordered list of agents that participated in the planning panel. Empty array when mode is single-agent.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this panel member within the session.

role.description: Role this member played in the panel (e.g. proposer, reviewer, arbiter).

resolvedModel.description: Effective model identifier used at runtime. Must be the canonical model ID as returned by the provider, not an alias or friendly name (e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-6', not 'sonnet').

policyVersion.description: Version of the routing policy that was active when this member was assigned.

roundsUsed.description: Number of deliberation rounds that actually ran.

roundsAllowed.description: Maximum number of deliberation rounds permitted by policy.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome of the planning session.

findings.description: Aggregate counts of findings produced during the planning session.

acceptedAsAssumption.description: Findings accepted as assumptions due to insufficient evidence.

openDissents.description: Finding IDs for which at least one panel member registered a dissent that was not resolved before the session closed.

planningCostUsd.description: Total cost of the planning session in US dollars.

planningDurationSec.description: Wall-clock duration of the planning session in seconds.
